critical_policy_notes: Subdomain takeover is NOT excluded here (unlike Grindr) -- takeover scanning is viable.

HIGHEST-VALUE bugs (auth flows: signup/login/MFA/OAuth, cross-portal CRM data leakage, the $15k-$20k CTF challenge) all require creating a HubSpot trial portal and authenticated testing -- explicitly OUT of scope for this hunt per user's no-account/no-auth-testing rule. This pass is CLI-only recon: takeover + config/secrets exposure + cloud buckets + nuclei, nothing requiring a portal account.

Original structured scope used unusual notation: 'app*.hubspot.com'/'api*.hubspot.com'/'api*.hubapi.com' (prefix wildcards, not standard *.suffix) and '*.hs-sites(-eu1)?.com' (regex-style optional group). Simplified to full *.hubspot.com / *.hubapi.com wildcards justified by the program's own catch-all scope entry ('Other HubSpot-owned (sub)domains not listed as Out of Scope', bounty-eligible) -- and hs-sites(-eu1)?.com split into two separate root domains.
chatspot.ai and hubspot.net are exact URL-type scope entries, not wildcards -- do not enumerate subdomains under them, check only the exact host.
